name: Illegal Immigration 2: Green Card Love
source:
Illegal Immigration 2: Green Card Love, a Visual Novel written by an actual immigrant. It contains life-like situations in a dramatic storyline, but it does not take itself too seriously. It has four different endings and original music and artwork.

Here you'll find a contrast between the First and the Third World. And you'll be definitely grateful for the Rule of Law.

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/adventure/illegal-immigration-2-green-card-love/62037/]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
《非法移民2：绿卡之恋》是一部由真正的移民创作的视觉小说。作品在戏剧性的故事中描写了贴近生活的情境，但并不会把自己看得太严肃。游戏有四个不同结局，以及原创音乐和美术。

在这里，你会看到第一世界与第三世界之间的对比，也一定会对法治心怀感激。

[摘自[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/adventure/illegal-immigration-2-green-card-love/62037/]GameJolt[/url]]
